lines.text: The commander releases Paul and has him stand before the Sanhedrin, and Paul says he has lived before God in all good conscience.
The centurion orders Paul struck on the mouth, and Paul says he did not know the man was the high priest.

wrong_details.true: The high priest Ananias orders Paul struck

lines.text: Paul says he is a Pharisee on trial for his hope in the resurrection, and the Pharisees and Sadducees split over it.
Some scribes from the Pharisees say they find nothing wrong with Paul and ask whether a spirit or an angel spoke to him.
The commander has soldiers bring Paul into the temple, and that night the Lord tells him to take courage and testify in Antioch.
